_about: The still screens behind the website-e homepage feature cards (hardpan-home.html, 25 cards in five rows) and the Try the GPS picture. Each card has two WebP sizes: 400 wide (the card) and the full capture (the full-screen viewer). RE-CAPTURE (Nov 10, 2026): hazards, range, my-bag and weekly-code were re-shot from the 2.0.5 web app code (release-205, 42ec9711) in headless Chrome at 390x844, deviceScaleFactor 3, on the repo's own Firebase stand-in and IAP stand-in (nothing live): demo golfers Sam, Josh, Bob, Paul; no amounts. Their older files stay in this folder, listed under superseded, and nothing serves them. Not part of the app: not in sw.js's shell list, not in the native bundle. LIVE ESRI (Manny, Nov 10): the Try the GPS picture is Esri World Imagery loaded live (16 z19 tiles in hardpan-home.html); the saved try-gps-dobson-7.webp is served by nothing (kept on disk, see try_gps). Strokes Gained, the Practice card and the Aim tip ship on Android 2.0.4 as on iPhone (Manny, Nov 10): no Coming soon on those cards, and none was pinned.
